purpose: Test whether the V31 donor conditional-rank field fails because it is not spatially registered to the query observables/backbone, using a target-free bounded translation and a matched shuffled-query causal control while preserving the exact donor identities, orientations, marginal coordinate, and density inverse.

inherited_inputs.selection_rule: reuse every V28/V31 source_index, donor_source, donor_index, and donor_isometry byte-for-byte; donor reselection is forbidden

train_only_descriptor_fit.data_and_cache: reuse and reverify the V35 kinematic3 train data and V21 train backbone cache for every source
train_only_descriptor_fit.grid: nonoverlapping factor-4 pooling of the native 64^3 cube to 16^3 cells (1.25 Mpc/h)
channels: exact individual-galaxy population radial-velocity dispersion reconstructed from count, mean, and unbiased native sig_v
mean frozen V14 corrected backbone including predicted residual DC
train_only_descriptor_fit.normalization: one common four-channel mean and standard deviation; compute each source moment over all of its train objects/cells, then average the three source moments with exactly one-third weight per source

query_aligned_transport.baseline: unchanged V31 conditional forward, frozen donor isometry, query conditional inverse, and exact residual-mean projection
query_aligned_transport.translation_candidates_coarse_cells: all integer triples in [-4,4]^3, corresponding to at most 5 Mpc/h per axis, including zero
query_aligned_transport.distance: mean squared difference across the four train-standardized 16^3 descriptor channels after applying the frozen donor isometry and a periodic coarse-grid roll
query_aligned_transport.selection: minimum descriptor distance; exact ties prefer smallest squared displacement and then lexicographic shift
query_aligned_transport.native_action: periodically roll the complete oriented donor conditional-rank cube by four native cells per selected coarse shift before the unchanged query conditional inverse
query_aligned_transport.aligned_arm: select the shift with the actual query descriptor
query_aligned_transport.shuffled_query_control: select the shift with the next frozen query descriptor cyclically within the same 16-object domain, but invert at the unchanged actual query backbone

development_evaluation.primary_pass: the aligned arm passes the unchanged field gate plus Q3 and Q4 independently in all three domains
development_evaluation.causal_alignment_material: aligned Q4/V31 <=0.75 and aligned Q4/shuffled_control <=0.90 in every domain
development_evaluation.selection_role: only the aligned arm can be selected; the shuffled arm is a negative control and cannot become a candidate

fixed_branches.condition: Q3 and Q4 pass all domains but any field check fails
causal_alignment_material but Q3 or Q4 still fails

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact program, parent record, V35 data/cache, V31 model/report, selections, and reference metric hashes
descriptor normalization uses train cubes only and is source balanced
FFT or direct shift scorer agrees with brute-force mean squared error and never returns a shift outside the frozen range
aligned and shuffled arms reuse identical donor identities and isometries
one real sample is finite and has exact residual DC below 1e-7
Astrid and historical EAGLE remain unopened
